versions.changelog:
Initial release of accessibility-scan (a11y-scan):

- Scan any public web page for WCAG 2.2 (ADA) accessibility issues using static HTML analysis.
- Reports only what automated tests can catch and clearly explains their scope and limitations.
- Supported endpoints include full and preview scans via HTTP GET, and MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0) for agent integration.
- No JavaScript/browser evaluation; focuses on static HTML accessibility checks such as alt text, labels, language, title, headings, and more.
- Honors `robots.txt`, includes strong SSRF protections, and clearly documents all limits and disclaimers.
